purpose: Teach: アトム/ウィルソン/ロジャー/琢磨/綾子/ユーゴ/金具/悪しき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「鉄腕アトムのアニメを一緒に観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "Let's watch the Astro Boy anime together."
lines.style: Soft, unhurried warmth; gentle lift on the quoted invitation, a fond smile audible throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとピアニスト、ウィルソンさんのコンサート観たよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, I went to a concert with Dad — the pianist, Mr. Wilson!
lines.style: Quiet child excitement building mid-line; careful pronunciation of the name, small proud finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロジャー・フェデラー伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been reading a biography of Roger Federer.
lines.style: Gentle, musing delivery; slowing slightly over the name, ending on a soft downward melody.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとF1の佐藤琢磨選手のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, Dad and I watched a documentary about Takuma Sato, the F1 driver!
lines.style: Pace quickening with enthusiasm; bright emphasis on the driver's name, breathless little rush to finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「あの綾子おばさんは素敵」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "That Aunt Ayako is such a lovely person."
lines.style: Hushed, almost confiding tone on the quote, warmth blooming through the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとユーゴ、つまりユーゴスラビア紛争の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, Dad and I read a picture book about Yugo — I mean, the Yugoslavia conflict.
lines.style: Careful, halting start on the tricky word, then a steady, earnest recovery to the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家具の金具を修理して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad kindly fixed the metal fittings on the furniture for us.
lines.style: Quiet appreciative tone; slight emphasis on the fixing, trailing into a contented near-hum.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「悪しき行いから離れて」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, Dad taught me to "stay away from wicked deeds."
lines.style: Slow and solemn for a six-year-old; the quote delivered with careful, borrowed gravity.
